Alternating-series remainder R_n is strictly decreasing from n=11, R_11=275267/2851200<1/6; since (exp(-1)+exp(-3))/2>1/6, all n>=11 are negative. Rational finite values establish exactly the n=2,3,5 zeros. Exact verifier replay passed 523 assertions including exhaustive edge priorities n=2..9. Finite tests support rather than substitute for the analytic all-n proof.

value.rationale: Boundary vacancy versus total occupied length is a natural finite-size measure of jamming dependence, not a chosen artificial parameter slice. The result fully classifies its sign including exceptional deterministic-cover sizes and proves a nonzero thermodynamic boundary-global limit. Marginal occupancy and total mean alone cannot determine this joint information; it isolates the boundary contribution to global fluctuations.
